fusions.name: Torpid Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a cold bolt that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Enervated] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Sluggish Crush
fusions.desc: Chills every enemy within 2 tiles for 4 damage, each with a 30% chance of [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Stock-Still
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Midday Bask
fusions.desc: By day, your armour rises by 15%.
